films.title: Passing Tests Is Not Shipping
films.question: What does a green task verifier leave unanswered about a patch?
films.takeaway: A passing patch can still make the next change harder.
films.out_of_scope: This does not argue that tests are weak or that every patch needs a study.

placement.what_to_watch: Track one passing patch as local success turns into repository ownership and removal cost.

scenes.headline: The verifier sees the outcome, not the trajectory.
support: The bounded task passes.
Three repository costs remain outside that verdict.

scenes.headline: Every surviving surface creates another ownership obligation.
support: The patch is cheap to generate.
Understanding, correcting, owning, and removing it are not.

scenes.headline: Generated, correct, mergeable, and maintainable are not synonyms.
support: Each rung needs additional evidence.
A lower rung cannot stand in for a higher one.

scenes.headline: Review burden is part of the patch’s output.
support: Two candidates may solve the same tasks.
The one requiring less repair leaves more capacity for the next change.

scenes.headline: Different gates answer different acceptance questions.
support: Compiler and tests reject known deterministic defects.
Review and cleanup examine ownership and trajectory.

scenes.headline: Known defects belong in CI; disagreement belongs in review.
support: Do not experimentalize a compiler error.
Do not pretend a green check settled architectural ownership.

scenes.headline: Maintainability frames both the question and the final decision.
support: The workflow begins with a repository problem.
It ends only when evidence supports a bounded acceptance decision.

films.title: The Eval Problem Is Not Scoring
films.audience: AI product engineers and eval owners
films.question: How can an aggregate winner be an artifact of missing coordinates?
films.takeaway: Denominators and independent evidence gates come before a winner.
films.out_of_scope: This does not combine incompatible evidence into a new synthetic score.

placement.what_to_watch: Watch unequal completion reverse the pooled result, then see how missing cells and four separate gates restore the planned decision.

scenes.headline: Candidate B wins inside both task strata.
support: Easy: 95% versus 90%.
Hard: 20% versus 10%.

scenes.headline: Unequal denominators make the baseline appear to win.
support: Candidate B: 27/60 = 45%.

scenes.headline: Fifty missing easy-task coordinates stay visible.
support: They are missing behavioral evidence.
They are neither failures nor permission to shrink the denominator.

scenes.headline: Infrastructure failure is not a low-quality answer.
support: A failed Sandbox yields no behavioral observation.
Scoring it zero silently changes the estimand.

scenes.headline: Four ledgers must each support the bounded decision.
support: Infrastructure, task outcome, judgment, and mechanism can disagree.
Their values remain separate.

scenes.headline: Task drift, retries, runtime, and judge leakage move results.
support: These variables belong in the comparison lock.
They do not belong in an interpretive footnote.

scenes.headline: Passing all gates authorizes one bounded statement.
support: Discordance remains visible.
Missing or invalid evidence blocks interpretation rather than lowering a score.

scenes.headline: Experimental design protects the path from evidence to decision.
support: Arithmetic summarizes observations.
Locks and ledgers determine what those observations can support.

visual.avoid: One aggregate score is the evaluation.

films.title: From Vibes to Studies
films.question: How does one readable comparison become exact, approved work?
films.takeaway: The same coordinates must survive preview, approval, execution, and result.
films.out_of_scope: The no-key replay proves installation and result shape, not Agent efficacy.

placement.what_to_watch: Follow one declared comparison as it expands into 32 obligations, receives a digest, crosses human approval, and becomes a reconciled result.

scenes.headline: A compact comparison expands into 32 terminal obligations.
support: 8 tasks × 2 candidates × 1 harness × 2 attempts.
Every coordinate must end in an explicit terminal state.

scenes.headline: A cell is more than a row number.
support: Task, candidate, harness, attempt, runtime, and evidence lock define it.
Changing one coordinate changes the planned work.

scenes.headline: Resolve and digest the plan before execution exists.
support: Preview performs no model call, preparation, or run-state write.
The digest names accepted meaning, not screen formatting.

scenes.headline: Approval grants execution, not authorship.
support: The accepted digest binds scope and spend.
Any edit creates a new digest and requires new approval.

scenes.headline: CLI, Python, REST, MCP, and Aria converge on one service.
support: Each interface must return the same preview digest.
No interface owns a private execution path.

scenes.headline: Sixteen aligned rows make the result contract tangible.
support: Baseline 2/8; candidate 6/8.
Five improved, one regressed, two unchanged.

scenes.headline: Replay evidence is smoke evidence, not efficacy evidence.
support: It checks packaging, parsing, and result projection.
Mechanism remains unavailable; no live Agent or Serverless runtime ran.

scenes.headline: Primitives preserve identity across the control plane.
support: Design becomes approved execution without changing meaning.
Evidence returns to the same declared coordinates.

visual.avoid: A replay demonstrates live Agent efficacy.

films.title: The Model Is Not the Agent
films.question: What exactly is the treatment when the same model runs through different harnesses?
films.takeaway: Report locked model–harness–environment candidates, not a model leaderboard.
films.out_of_scope: The preregistration contains no observed winner or causal harness result.

placement.what_to_watch: See how candidate identity, paired assignment, ordering, and reporting rules prevent a harness comparison from becoming a model leaderboard.

scenes.headline: One model can produce several behavioral candidates.
support: Harness, environment, tools, and stopping policy change observable behavior.
The model name alone is not the reporting unit.

scenes.headline: Each harness candidate receives the same locked task coordinates.
support: Task identity and attempt index align the comparison.
A missing coordinate remains missing.

scenes.headline: Counterbalance execution order before observing outcomes.
support: Half the blocks begin with A; half begin with B.
Warm caches and temporal drift cannot become the treatment by accident.

scenes.headline: Estimate paired candidate differences under locked conditions.
support: The reporting unit is model–harness–environment.
The design does not estimate a universal model ranking.

scenes.headline: A reversal is a result, not a reason to pool.
support: Candidate A can lead on one task family while B leads on another.
Separate reporting preserves the interaction.

scenes.headline: Protocol differences can prevent a pure harness claim.
support: If adapters or tool semantics differ, report the full candidates.
Do not subtract away behavior-changing preparation.

visual.lock: ATTRIBUTE ONLY WHAT THE LOCKED CONTRAST SUPPORTS

scenes.headline: No difference and harness reversal are both publishable outcomes.
support: The design is useful even when there is no winner.
Incomplete infrastructure can still make the study uninterpretable.

visual.forbidden: PICK A WINNER AFTER SEEING RESULTS

scenes.headline: Harness identity belongs inside experimental design.
support: It travels with the candidate through execution and evidence.
The final claim remains bounded to that locked system.

visual.avoid: This design identifies a best model or harness.

films.title: Memory Is Not Context
films.audience: Context, retrieval, MCP, and developer-tool teams
films.question: What can a retrieval trace honestly establish about evidence use?
films.takeaway: Returned, opened, used, and successful are separate events with separate denominators.
films.out_of_scope: Mechanism evidence does not by itself prove that memory caused task success.

placement.what_to_watch: Follow evidence through the mechanism funnel, inspect one aligned row, then place those observations inside the planned 2×2 intervention.

scenes.headline: Most returned evidence never becomes used evidence.
support: 12 sources returned; 3 opened; 1 used.
Across four attempts, 0 tasks passed.

scenes.headline: The Agent opened the evidence but did not satisfy the declared use relation.
support: Assigned 1/1; returned 1/1; opened 1/1; used 0/1.
The official task still passed.

scenes.headline: The row supports an audit statement, not a causal story.
support: Supported: the locked source was returned and opened.
Unsupported: memory caused the pass.

scenes.headline: Separate memory from the evidence-use policy.
support: Two interventions produce four legal arms.
Their interaction is estimated rather than assumed.

scenes.headline: A vector failure cannot silently become vector success.
support: Fallback is a structured failure or a distinct candidate.
The explicit BM25 arm keeps its own identity.

visual.forbidden: VECTOR FAILED → SILENT BM25 → VECTOR SUCCESS

scenes.headline: More retrieved text can displace instructions or task evidence.
support: Delivery policy belongs in candidate identity.
Usage and latency are secondary outcomes, not free capacity.

visual.label: FIXED CONTEXT WINDOW
visual.warning: BROAD RETRIEVAL CAN DISPLACE TASK CONTEXT

scenes.headline: Localization can improve without completion improving.
support: Policy may help without memory helping.
Cost can rise without any evidence uptake.

scenes.headline: Mechanism evidence explains where a treatment reached—not why it won.
support: The funnel strengthens evidence integrity.
The controlled comparison still determines the outcome claim.

visual.avoid: A retrieved path proves evidence use or causation.

films.title: API Compatibility Is Not Agent Compatibility
films.question: What must be locked before an MCP release can receive a behavioral recommendation?
films.takeaway: Qualify exact MCP revisions as whole Agent-facing releases.
films.out_of_scope: Prepared evidence and planned cells are not an observed release result.

placement.what_to_watch: Track exact revisions through manifest qualification, genuine evidence, the staged 80-cell design, judge calibration, and the still-blocked decision.

scenes.headline: The comparison begins with exact MCP revisions.
support: Baseline: 80252b3…
Candidate: a2bae72…

scenes.headline: Descriptions, projections, pagination, and errors are behavioral inputs.
support: Target-platform probes record the exact tool manifest.
Protocol compatibility alone cannot establish Agent compatibility.

scenes.headline: Genuine W&B objects seed the maintainer questions.
support: 6 Runs, 24 conversations, 48 tool spans.
8 Dataset rows, 2 Evaluations, 16 prediction rows.

scenes.headline: Discovery precedes untouched primary and replication cohorts.
support: 8 Claude + 8 W&B Inference discovery.
32 Claude primary + 32 W&B Inference replication.

scenes.headline: Forty-eight double-reviewed cases must qualify the judge.
support: TPR and TNR must each reach at least 0.85.
Zero critical false passes are permitted.

scenes.headline: Four outcome layers remain independently inspectable.
support: Conformance, deterministic, judgment, and mechanism answer different questions.
A release memo cannot hide failure in an aggregate.

scenes.headline: Prepared evidence does not unlock a release recommendation.
support: Evidence, candidate, taskset, judge, preview, and runtime locks must all exist.
The 80 cells and reconciliation remain unobserved.

scenes.headline: An MCP release spans design, execution, evidence, and decision.
support: The whole locked release is the treatment.
No individual 0.4 feature receives causal credit.

visual.avoid: One MCP feature caused an improvement.

films.title: Telemetry Is Not Evaluation
films.question: What authority boundaries turn observations into reversible engineering?
films.takeaway: A learning loop requires immutable proposals, external evaluation, and reversible decisions.
films.out_of_scope: More telemetry alone does not create an evaluator or approval authority.

placement.what_to_watch: Follow an authority failure into a governed Study state machine with separate proposal, approval, execution, evaluation, retry, and rollback powers.

scenes.headline: The proposer sees a weak result and edits the experiment.
support: One more retry and a narrower taskset appear locally reasonable.
Together they optimize against the evaluator.

scenes.headline: Observation becomes a new proposal, not a hidden retry.
support: Observe → hypothesize → preregister → approve.
Execute → evaluate → interpret → decide.

scenes.headline: Proposer, approver, executor, and evaluator do different work.
support: Aria may select and explain a registered comparison.
It may not approve, retry, or rewrite accepted meaning.

visual.forbidden: FORBIDDEN: ONE ROLE OWNS ALL FOUR STEPS

scenes.headline: Accepted meaning moves forward; it is never edited in place.
support: A changed candidate, task, cap, or retry policy creates a new Study.
Every coordinate reaches an explicit terminal state.

scenes.headline: Recovery cannot silently add evidence after approval.
support: Retry rules are part of the accepted plan.
Rollback names the candidate and data boundary to restore.

scenes.headline: Digest mismatch, missing evidence, and cleanup failure block progress.
support: They remain visible in durable Study state.
The loop does not manufacture a low score or a success.

scenes.headline: Reject, accept, and learn are distinct terminal decisions.
support: A null result remains durable research evidence.
It can motivate a new question without launching it.

scenes.headline: Governance closes the evidence loop without closing inquiry.
support: Authority boundaries protect the current decision.
A new hypothesis begins a new locked cycle.

visual.avoid: More telemetry makes a self-governing evaluator.

films.title: From a Trace to a Release Decision
films.audience: Teams evaluating the complete Aria–Fugue workflow
films.question: What receipts must exist before a live workflow supports a release decision?
films.takeaway: A credible workflow links genuine evidence, exact approval, remote work, reconciliation, and cleanup.
films.out_of_scope: No completed 80-cell Study, live follow-up, or release memo is claimed.

placement.what_to_watch: Treat the workflow as a qualification contract: prepared evidence and approval are real boundaries, while remote execution and the final memo remain required and unobserved.

scenes.headline: The story begins with genuine evidence, not a stage script.
support: Runs, conversations, Dataset, and Evaluations exist before the comparison.
They seed the question; they are not the 80-cell result.

scenes.headline: The approval card binds exact meaning and spend.
support: Candidate and runtime identities, 80 cells, judge, mechanism, and budget are visible.
Digest mismatch refuses execution.

scenes.headline: Each approved cell needs one complete Serverless lifecycle.
support: Create, attest, execute, publish, and delete.
One conversation, root, prediction, Evaluation row, and receipt must reconcile.

scenes.eyebrow: FAILURE IS PART OF THE CONTRACT
scenes.headline: Mismatch, missing evidence, null outcome, and orphan cleanup stop the story.
support: None becomes an improvised success.
The audience sees the blocked state and its receipt.

scenes.headline: Weave and Study rows must agree before interpretation.
support: Every aggregate opens aligned baseline and candidate evidence.
Missing trace, Evaluation, usage, or cleanup evidence blocks eligibility.

scenes.headline: The flagship exists only after every qualification gate passes.
support: Exact identities, calibrated judge, 80 reconciled cells, and clean-clone rehearsals.
A null or incomplete Study is valid but not presentation-ready.

scenes.headline: A maintainer memo is the last artifact, not the first narrative.
support: It needs improved, regressed, and unchanged cases plus direct evidence links.
It must state limitations and leave the next question unexecuted.

scenes.headline: The flagship is the whole evidence chain—or it is not ready.
support: Approval, remote execution, evidence, decision, and cleanup stay linked.
No stage prop substitutes for a receipt.

visual.avoid: Prepared evidence proves the live workflow completed.

films.title: Building the Evaluator with the Evaluated
films.question: What does Agent-assisted evaluator development prove—and what does it not prove?
films.takeaway: Auditable co-development improves the process; external boundaries establish evaluator trust.
films.out_of_scope: Agent productivity and PR volume do not validate the evaluator.

placement.what_to_watch: Inspect the public PR stack, the defects and cleanup decisions it records, and the external boundaries that prevent the evaluator from grading its own homework.

scenes.headline: Four public heads record distinct integration layers.
support: #42 cleanup; #43 control; #44 qualification; #45 Serverless.
The stack is process evidence, not evaluator validation.

scenes.headline: A label stopped standing in for candidate identity.
support: Behavior-changing inputs became explicit fingerprints.
The same resolved identity must reach render, run, snapshot, and result.

scenes.headline: Qualification found a runtime defect before the claim shipped.
support: The exact candidate tree—not a nearby branch—was exercised.
The defect report remains development evidence until publicly linked.

visual.forbidden: QUALIFY NEARBY TREE → CLAIM EXACT HEAD

scenes.headline: Static findings became an adjudication queue, not a delete command.
support: Remove, prove a caller, or document dynamic use.
Persisted readers and registered callbacks require ownership evidence.

scenes.headline: Agents implement and inspect; humans set claims and approval.
support: Repository-local plans, schemas, locks, and tests make work legible.
Authorship does not grant evaluation authority.

scenes.headline: The evaluated system cannot rewrite its holdout or approve itself.
support: External evaluation and private facts stay outside the candidate.
A human remains the release authority.

visual.rule: CANDIDATE CANNOT REWRITE THE RIGHT SIDE

scenes.headline: Public commits and checks are auditable; local anecdotes remain bounded.
support: Files, additions, deletions, tests, and head identities can be reopened.
Productivity and evaluator validity remain separate ledgers.

scenes.headline: Co-development can improve the factory without validating its evaluator.
support: Agent legibility strengthens design and maintenance.
Holdout evidence and approval still bound the final decision.

visual.avoid: Building the evaluator proves the evaluator is correct.
